claims.raw_statement: Among partial cubes: Q_n minus two antipodes, n ≥ 3. Conditioning-minimal non-ampleness: uniform-OM tope classes, with the rank-one qualification.

This family is itself the c-obstruction basis of Amp, outside Amp. With at least three concepts: non-free simple uniform-oriented-matroid tope classes. Two-concept cases are antipodal pairs on at least two coordinates.
N plus its proper conditionings (all ample)
N plus its ample pc-minors; ample part not classified here
The source family is p-closed. Its c or pc closure has an obstruction problem distinct from recognition of Max itself.
Nonample pc obstructions are exactly Q_n minus two antipodes; the remaining ample obstruction family may be empty. Nonample c obstructions are all minimal non-ample classes.

A class belongs when it is a coordinate section of a finite maximum class that admits a corner peeling. Auxiliary dimension and parent rank are unrestricted. No intrinsic obstruction basis is supplied.

Ext is local notation for the existing universal cube-extension property: C has a representation map and every such map extends to the full displayed cube. Equivalently, both C and its cube complement have representation maps, with empty sides allowed; equivalently, C is a forward-invariant set of some cube unique-sink orientation.
Geometric construction by affine hyperplanes inside an open convex set; pc-obstruction basis not inventoried in this pass.
Relative-attachment generation and structural reductions are proved; an intrinsic complete pc-obstruction generator remains open.

The Yang complex is pure one-decomposable: the recursive shedding faces have at most two vertices. Equivalently, use the attachment recursion with coordinate blocks of size at most two. An intrinsic pc-obstruction basis is not supplied here.

The Yang complex is pure two-decomposable: recursive shedding faces have at most three vertices. Equivalently, the attachment C=A∪(S×{p}) uses 1≤|J|≤3, A[p]=∅, and S contained in every other J-shore, with A and S recursively in D₂. An intrinsic pc-obstruction basis is not supplied here.

Both the class and its complement in the displayed coordinate cube admit corner peelings; the empty complement is permitted. This is cube complementation, not graph complementation. An intrinsic pc-obstruction basis is not supplied here.
Contains MaxMin and Damp. Nonample pc obstructions are the ample-class basis; possible additional ample obstructions remain unknown.

Defined by nonnegative weights on facet-topped Yang intervals covering every face, including the empty face, with total weight one. No complete intrinsic obstruction basis is known; Frac = Amp is equivalent to equality of their pc-obstruction sets.
Standard median recognition is available; its operation-specific obstruction bases are not reproduced by this inventory.
Complete generative pc basis with both soundness and exhaustive recovery, rather than a finite list.
Complete four-state coordinate criterion and repair test for pc-obstruction membership; a simpler intrinsic generator is still desirable.
p-minimal nonmembers are the appropriate basis for the original class. Infinite construction families are proved; completeness remains open.
Convex-geometry ideals, up to signed coordinates
Convex-geometry ideals, up to signed coordinates
Every finite partial cube is a conditioning of a tree-like partial cube. Thus its pc closure has no excluded partial cubes.
Exact generator: upper ideal in a learning space, followed by coordinate reflection; one marker conditioning suffices. A forbidden-minor basis is not classified here.
C belongs to P_k exactly when it is a c-minor of a maximum class in D_k. Parent rank and auxiliary coordinates are unrestricted.
C is ample and its complement in the displayed cube is dismantlable; the empty complement is allowed. B = Damp ∩ coDamp.

A displayed class C belongs to M_k exactly when it is obtained from a maximum class by conditioning exactly k coordinates; padding makes this equivalent to at most k. Constant visible coordinates must be retained for this entry.
A displayed class belongs to M₁ exactly when it is obtained from a maximum class by conditioning at most 1 coordinates; padding permits exactly 1. Visible constant coordinates are retained.
A displayed class belongs to M₂ exactly when it is obtained from a maximum class by conditioning at most 2 coordinates; padding permits exactly 2. Visible constant coordinates are retained.
